climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A North Carolina AVA of 96,000 acres with 75 acres of vines, in Iredell, Wilkes and Yadkin counties. Its northern 60 percent lies inside the Yadkin Valley AVA and the rest extends south of it. It was created in 2008.
